description_ar: مستقبلي صاخب: بنفسجي ونيون سماوي ووردي، تأثيرات glitch، توهج قوي، كلمات ضخمة متتابعة.
description_en: Loud futuristic look: violet with cyan and pink neon, glitch effects, strong glows and huge kinetic words.
scene_blueprint_en: Hook: a giant glitch-in word with a cyan/violet glowing shadow over a dark violet gradient and fast particles.
Middle: rapid scenes (1.5-2.5 s) each carrying one punchy phrase, alternating zoom / slide-right / blur-in.
Outro: pulsing neon pill button and a typewriter tagline.
rules_en: Use colored shadows (blur 30-60, y 0) in cyan/pink for neon glow.
Alternate scene backgrounds between violet and cyan-tinted gradients.
Add decorative lines/circles (shapes) with low opacity for a HUD feel.
